name: Ray Origin Jitter for Mesh Voxelization
definition: A technique to fix vertical slice artifacts in mesh voxelization by adding a small jitter to ray origins, preventing numerical instability when rays align exactly with mesh vertices or edges.
summary: Ray Origin Jitter eliminates vertical slice artifacts in mesh voxelization by adding a small offset to ray origins perpendicular to their direction, preserving geometric fidelity unlike SDF approaches.
